column1: # Shared redaction vectors: tst_core::url::redact_url and org.tstrans.Redact.url must map
# each input to its expected output byte for byte. One row per line, input<TAB>expected;
# lines starting with # and blank lines are skipped.
# A row must not hold a lone carriage return: the Java reader splits lines on it, Rust does not.
# A raw ? before the last @ is password text, even with an = after it.
# Accepted over-redaction: a query value holding an @ is read as userinfo.
# Accepted over-redaction: any later @ ends the userinfo.
# A URL opened right after a quote runs to the last matching quote before the next URL opened by
# the same quote, when that quote is followed by a separator, , ; . : ) ] } or the end; otherwise
# it runs to that next URL or the end of the input.
# Accepted over-redaction: a later quoted word joins the URL's span.
# Accepted over-redaction: an apostrophe inside a later word extends the span to the end.
# Only a later URL opened by the same quote ends the span; a bare scheme-looking word does not.
# A quote inside a secret with no closing quote after it does not end the span.
